title: Mark Antony dies as Octavian takes Alexandria
summary: As Octavian's army entered Alexandria, Mark Antony stabbed himself on hearing a false report of Cleopatra's death and died in her arms. Cleopatra killed herself days later.
reason: After Actium, Antony's forces deserted him, and Octavian advanced on Egypt to finish the war.
significance: Egypt became a Roman province, ending the last great Hellenistic kingdom.
